name: tern
displayName: TERN — Telemetry for Engineering & Reasoning Norms
description: Zero-distraction in-IDE overlay for developer studies: fatigue Likert sampling, stuck detection with inline code prompts, and session telemetry.
author: Idrees Razak

tern.participantId.description: Default participant ID (can be overridden when starting a session).

tern.condition.description: A/B study condition for this session.

tern.session.durationMinutes.description: Study session length in minutes. The end-of-study survey opens automatically when time is up.

tern.fatigue.intervalMinutes.description: How often the fatigue Likert prompt appears during a session.

tern.fatigue.waitForPauseSeconds.description: The fatigue prompt waits for a typing pause of at least this many seconds before appearing (zero-distraction). It gives up waiting after 60s and shows anyway.

tern.fatigue.jitterPercent.description: Randomize each fatigue probe interval by ±this percent so participants can't anticipate probes (reduces experience-sampling reactivity). 0 = strictly periodic.

tern.fatigue.quietTailMinutes.description: Suppress fatigue probes during the final minutes of the session - a probe answered just before the debrief is redundant and annoying.

tern.stuck.enabled.description: Detect when the participant appears stuck and show an inline prompt on the code.

tern.stuck.thresholdSeconds.description: Seconds of dwelling on the same code region without edits (while still active) before the stuck prompt appears.

tern.stuck.languages.description: Language IDs to watch for stuck detection (e.g. ["python"]). Empty = all languages.

tern.ideHealth.enabled.description: Capture aggregate IDE diagnostic and build/test counts (content-free; FR-INST-18).

tern.ideHealth.debounceSeconds.description: Debounce window in seconds before flushing a diagnostics-count event.

tern.comprehensionProbe.enabled.description: Show comprehension probes when the participant accepts an AI-produced chunk (predict-output / locate-change; FR-INST-19).

tern.comprehensionProbe.cadence.description: How often to probe: every accepted AI chunk, or a sampled subset.

tern.comprehensionProbe.sampleRate.description: Fraction of accepted chunks to probe (0–1). Only meaningful when cadence is 'sampled'.

tern.comprehensionProbe.probeTypes.description: Which probe types may appear. If empty, no probes are shown.

tern.session.taskId.description: Protocol task ID recorded in the environment snapshot (replication provenance).

tern.session.agentTool.description: AI agent tool used in the ai-assisted condition (e.g. claude-code), recorded in the environment snapshot.

tern.session.agentModelId.description: Model identifier of the AI agent (e.g. claude-fable-5), recorded in the environment snapshot.

tern.behavior.enabled.description: Master switch for the behavioral telemetry leg (focus, scroll, edit bursts, clipboard, AI lifecycle, saves, heartbeats).

tern.behavior.captureFocus.description: Record editor/tab focus switches and window focus state (editor_focus events).

tern.behavior.captureVisibleRanges.description: Record debounced visible line ranges for scroll-coverage analysis (visible_range events).

tern.behavior.captureEditBursts.description: Record aggregated edit bursts with origin classification (edit_burst events). Sizes and shapes only - never text content.

tern.behavior.captureClipboard.description: Record clipboard paste sizes and internal-copy latency (clipboard_paste events). Clipboard text is never read or stored.

tern.behavior.captureAiLifecycle.description: Record the AI-completion lifecycle: shown/accepted/rejected/dismissed with review latency (ai_suggestion events).

tern.behavior.captureAttention.description: Record region-level time-on-code from caret + mouse-hover dwell (attention events). Line numbers and durations only - never code content.

tern.behavior.languages.description: Language IDs captured by the behavioral leg (pilot: python only). Empty = all languages.

tern.behavior.workspaceInternalOnly.description: Capture only files inside the workspace. Files outside are recorded as 'external' in focus events and otherwise ignored.

tern.behavior.burstGapMs.description: An edit burst closes after this many milliseconds without further edits.

tern.behavior.aiCorrelationMs.description: An edit burst within this window of an accepted AI suggestion is classified origin=ai.

tern.behavior.aiBlockCharThreshold.description: A block of at least this many characters landing within aiBlockMaxDurationMs is classified origin=ai (injected, not typed).

tern.behavior.aiBlockMaxDurationMs.description: Window for the AI block-injection heuristic - humans do not type aiBlockCharThreshold characters this fast.

tern.behavior.pasteCorrelationMs.description: An edit burst within this window of a clipboard paste is classified origin=paste.

tern.behavior.idleWindowSeconds.description: No interaction for this long marks the participant idle (heartbeat state transition).

tern.behavior.focusDebounceMs.description: Debounce for editor focus switches - rapid tab-cycling records first + last.

tern.behavior.attentionRegionRadiusLines.description: Caret/hover may wander +/- this many lines and still count as the same attention region.

tern.behavior.attentionMinDwellMs.description: Attention regions with less present-and-active time than this are dropped as pass-through glances.

tern.output.directory.description: Directory for JSONL study data. Empty = <workspace>/.study-data (or extension global storage if no workspace).

tern.output.httpEndpoint.description: Optional middleware endpoint to POST event batches to (e.g. http://localhost:8000/cognitive). Empty = disabled.

tern.studyId.description: The study this IDE is paired to (set automatically when you connect).
